name: Global Engine Group Holding Limited
summary: Global Engine Group Holding Limited, based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, provides comprehensive services specializing in information and communication technology (ICT), system integration, and expert technical consulting. The company's offerings include a range of ICT solutions such as cloud platform implementation, IT system architecture, setup, and ongoing maintenance, as well as data center co-location and cloud services. It also delivers dedicated technical support, development, and outsourcing capabilities for critical infrastructure like data centers and cloud computing environments, mobile and fixed network communications, and Internet of Things (IoT) initiatives. Additionally, the firm extends its expertise to project management services. Global Engine Group caters to a diverse clientele, including telecommunications operators, providers of data center and cloud computing services, and a variety of IoT stakeholders, from solution developers and resellers to end-users. The company was established in 2021.
